notes.title: Chapter Map added! - v1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340896/6be5e3c619c887aa9a5efae12519468385214bbd.png[/img]

[b]v1.0.1 now released![/b]

[list]
[*][b] Chapter map[/b], now you can play any level completed if you want to changue choices and try another ways to the end(instead of starting a new game again).
[*] Increased sprint speed in Delivery Man chapter.
[*] Increased sprint speed and health in Thief of Diamonds chapter.
[/list]
